name: Mai-chan wa Hatten Tojou
original_name: まいちゃんは発展途上
source:
Timid college girl Mai-chan takes further steps toward being her own woman.
But her particular staircase doesn't go up...

The (continued) story of a silly, indecisive college freshman who ends up doing porn.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE160211.html]DLsite English[/url]]
